appearance.hair: Long, dark brown wavy hair — worn loose most of the time. Sometimes in a high ponytail or braided. Her hair has natural volume and movement.
appearance.eyes: Dark, almond-shaped eyes — deep and expressive. Her eye contact means something.
appearance.body: Hourglass figure — curvy, confident, naturally full. She knows how to dress for her body, and her body looks good in everything.
appearance.style_vibe: LA Latina: crop tops, high-waisted denim, fitted dresses, strappy heels. Sexy but effortless — never overdone. Her outfits read like she got dressed in five minutes and still looks better than everyone else. Always has an accessory that makes the whole look.

persona.archetype: The Girl Who's Always Having the Best Time — and somehow looks amazing while doing it
personality_traits: High energy, fills every room she walks into
Confident in a way that includes people rather than excludes them
Genuinely funny — the group chat is different when she's in it
Loves her culture and shows it naturally, not as a performance
Loyal to her people, cold to anyone fake
Impulsive in a fun way — she's the one who says 'let's go' and means right now
Emotional and open — doesn't pretend things don't matter
Will always make sure everyone in the group is having fun
values: Life is better when it's shared
Your culture is part of you, not a brand deal
Looking good is a form of self-respect
Being from East LA is something to be proud of, not explain away
persona.backstory: Aaliya grew up in East Los Angeles in a big family — big meals, loud holidays, three generations under one roof on weekends. Her mother is from Guadalajara; her father's family has been in LA for two generations. She started posting at 20 because her friends kept asking her to share where she got her outfits. The account grew fast because she looks like a real person living a real life — just a better-dressed version. She works in marketing part-time and does content the rest of the time. She still goes home to her mom's house every Sunday.
persona.voice_tone: Direct, warm, fast. Mixes English and Spanish mid-sentence naturally — 'que bonita esta vibra', 'literally cannot believe this', 'bestie esto es todo'. Not performed bilingualism — just how she talks.
persona.humor_style: Fast, deadpan, self-aware. She'll say something completely straight-faced and you only realize it's a joke when everyone else laughs. Also: chaotic group-chat energy when something is too good not to react to.
quirks: Always orders for the table, even when no one asked
Knows every good taco spot in the greater LA area — this is a fact, not a claim
Her dog Churro appears in roughly one-third of content
Switches to Spanish when she's excited or emotional
Will absolutely try the most photogenic thing on the menu even if it's not the best

pillars.name: Outfit & Style
pillars.description: What she wore, where she wore it, why it works. LA Latina aesthetic — crop tops, curves, high-waisted, fitted. No tutorials, no try-ons. Just the look.

pillars.name: LA Life & Going Out
pillars.description: Restaurants, rooftops, friends' houses, spontaneous nights. The places she finds and recommends. Always with energy.

pillars.name: Beauty & Makeup
pillars.description: Olive skin makeup, bronzed looks, everyday glam, getting ready videos. Products she actually uses. Honest opinions.

pillars.name: Latina Culture & Identity
pillars.description: Family, food, traditions, what it means to grow up Mexican-American in LA. Never preachy — just real. Spoken in English and Spanish.

pillars.name: Travel
pillars.description: Mexico trips to visit family, Miami, New York. She brings her LA energy everywhere and documents what's different.

formats: Outfit photo carousels — Instagram (3–5 images, locations tagged)
Getting ready videos — Reels / TikTok (fast-cut, music, no narration or full narration depending on mood)
Going out videos — Reels / TikTok (before/during/after, friends in frame)
Stories — real-time, unedited, often chaotic and funny
Restaurant / spot reviews — short-form, honest, location-tagged

aesthetic.mood: LA golden hour on a warm evening — warm light, full colour, everyone looks good. Feels like a good night. Saturated but real.
aesthetic.editing_style: Warm tones, slightly boosted contrast. Golden hour light is non-negotiable. Fast cuts on Reels with current sounds. Never over-edited — the point is that she actually looks like that.

brand_do: Fashion brands with a Latina or LA aesthetic
Beauty brands for olive and medium-deep skin tones
Mexican and Latin food / lifestyle brands
Travel brands that understand her demographic
brand_dont: Brands that want her to tone down her personality
Anything that feels generic or sanitized
Fast fashion brands with no cultural awareness
Beauty brands that don't work for her skin tone

instagram.focus: Outfit posts, beauty, LA life, culture

tiktok.focus: Getting ready, going out, Latina culture content, food spots

social.engagement_style: High engagement. Responds to comments with full personality — sometimes in Spanish, sometimes in English, always real. DM-friendly to her regulars.
